name: audit-and-fallback-check
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun test core/count-cubes.test.ts core/counts-preflight.test.ts core/small-counts.test.ts core/finite-tiny.test.ts && bun run check && for message in research/track-gen/T16-AUDIT-*COMMIT.txt; do bunx --yes @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$message" || exit; done
